# CipherExam

> Certification exam practice that teaches how the exam reasons. Every question is
> classified by Bloom's taxonomy level, and each explanation works through why the
> distractors fail rather than restating the correct answer.

CipherExam covers PMP and the CompTIA certifications — Security+ (SY0-701),
Network+ (N10-009) and A+ Core 2 (220-1202) — including native CompTIA
performance-based questions (PBQs), full-length exam simulators, per-domain
readiness scoring and a study plan anchored to the weakest domain.

The premise is that most candidates who fail these exams do not fail on facts.
They fail on reasoning: a question can test recall, application or analysis of the
same knowledge, and flashcard-style prep only ever trains the first. Results are
broken out by Bloom's level so a candidate can tell a knowledge gap from a
judgment gap, which need different remedies. Each certification also has its own
"Exam Lens" — the reasoning frame that exam grades against.

Pricing: a permanently free Starter tier (daily quiz, progress tracking,
explanations); Pro at $19/month; or a one-time $59 Exam Pass covering one exam for
90 days with no auto-renew.

- [CompTIA A+ Core 2 Practice](https://cipherexam.com/lp/a-plus-core-2): 220-1202, order-first troubleshooting
